title: First Generation Plus Success Center (USC)
text:
DEFINITION
- 'We define first generation students as those whose parents do not have four-year degrees.'

WHO IS SERVED
- First-generation students
- Transfer students
- Undocumented students and students from mixed-status families
- Former foster youth

SERVICES AND PROGRAMS
- Resources, programs, and mentorship to help students navigate campus life, build connections, and achieve academic and personal success
- Academic and professional development programming
- Free, confidential immigration legal consultations, legal assistance, and referrals through the USC Gould Immigrant Legal Assistance Center (ILAC), held as drop-in hours at FG+SC
- Weekly on-site mental health support from an embedded counselor, Mondays 3:00-4:00 p.m., with telehealth also available
- Community-building events, listed at linktr.ee/firstgenplussc

HOW TO GET CONNECTED
- Schedule a counseling appointment through the MySHR student health portal or call (213) 740-9355 (WELL)
- Book an ILAC consultation at calendly.com/usc-ilac, or call or email
- Email FG+SC, follow on Instagram, or sign up for the newsletter

CONTACTS
- Email: firstgen@usc.edu
- ILAC phone: 213-821-9627; ILAC email: iclinic@law.usc.edu
- Counseling phone: (213) 740-9355 (WELL)

LOCATION AND HOURS
- 3607 Trousdale Parkway, TCC 224, Los Angeles, CA 90089
- Monday-Friday, 9 a.m.-5 p.m. Extended hours are posted on Instagram.
